notes.title: Deep Under release!
notes.notes: Deep Under is now available for purchase with 20% discount for the next 2 weeks. We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: The demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The story prologue is available now. 
You can play the demo until the end of Steam Next Fest.

notes.title: Demo and release date reveal!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44414792/38112a8cdb1c0dc069b1b8a7683883d765814145.png[/img]

Hi everyone, we are happy to announce the release date of [b]Deep Under[/b] on Steam - [b]April 11, 2024[/b]!

There's still a long time to wait for the release, but you'll be able to play the demo very soon.
The story prologue will be available on [b]February 2, 2024[/b]!
